uncertain_sources.resolution: The spoken shortcut that the OR of compatible properties is the sum of their projectors is valid only for mutually exclusive subspaces; the chapter gives the general commuting-projector formula P or Q = P + Q - PQ and then states the orthogonal special case.
A live exchange mixes orthogonality, relative sign, and Bell-state labels; the chapter separates these notions and retains the physical role of the relative phase.
The delayed-apparatus thought experiment is retained cautiously and tied to the need for a definite spacetime arrangement.
The qualitative weak-measurement discussion is expressed through nonorthogonal record states and their overlap without inventing an apparatus-specific model.
